### Observed differences

- In the later window, A22 appears in about 53 in 100 traces (mean 0.53 occurrences per trace, never repeated), whereas in the earlier window it appeared exactly once in every trace; its co-occurrence with A06 and with A07 also fell from about 45 in 100 traces to about 25 in 100, with neither activity present in about 25 in 100 later traces. [OCC001, REL001, REL006]
- Four activities that were not observed at all in the earlier window — A27, A28, A33 and A34 — each now appear in about 47 in 100 traces, once per trace when present. [OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005]
- These four behave as one block: every pair of them co-occurs in about 47 in 100 traces, both orders occur for each pair (roughly 20–27 in 100 traces each way, so no fixed internal order), and they never appear together with A22 — about 53 in 100 later traces have A22 only, about 47 in 100 have the four activities only. [REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020]
- The block sits between A21 and A23: before, every observed outgoing transition of A21 went to A22 and A21, A22 and A23 always occurred together in that order; in the later window about 53 in 100 of A21's outgoing transitions still go to A22 while the rest go to A34 (about 15), A33 (about 12), A27 (about 11) and A28 (about 10), A21 occurs without A22 in about 47 in 100 traces (previously never), A23 occurs without A22 in about 47 in 100 traces, and the step distance from A21 to A23 is 5 in about 47 in 100 cases instead of always 2. [DIR002, REL011, REL012, REL016, LAG001]
- The four activities route onward to each other and to A23 — for example about 33 in 100 of A27's outgoing transitions go to A23, the remainder to A28, A34 and A33 — and A23 is now preceded by each of them in about 47 in 100 traces. [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024]
- Positionally, the four activities sit around the middle of the trace (mean relative position about 0.49–0.50), and A23's mean relative position shifts only slightly later, from about 0.53 to 0.55. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS001]
- A separate difference concerns A06: its outgoing transitions shifted toward A07 (about 26 in 100 before, about 47 in 100 after), with fewer going to A08 (about 39 to 31) and A09 (about 35 to 22), based on roughly 90 observed outgoing transitions per window. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, roughly half of the executions run an alternative segment between A21 and A23 in which A22 is skipped and a block of four activities — A27, A28, A33 and A34, executed in varying order — appears in their place, while the remaining executions still follow the former A21 → A22 → A23 segment. [OCC001, OCC002, DIR002, REL011, REL016, REL025, LAG001]

This rests on direct, mutually consistent relational and directional evidence rather than on frequency counts alone: A21's outgoing transitions now include the four activities, the four lead to A23 and to one another, A22 and the block are strictly mutually exclusive, and the A21-to-A23 step distance lengthens from 2 to 5 in about 47 in 100 cases — matching the share of traces containing the block. Occurrence, direction, relation, position and lag indicators all reflect this same underlying difference, and the two distinct differences visible in the evidence (this segment change and the A06 routing shift) clearly exceed the roughly 0.5 items screening expects by chance in an unchanged process. [DIR002, DIR003, REL017, REL021, LAG001, OCC001, DIR001]

Limitations: zero participation in the earlier window only means A27, A28, A33 and A34 were not observed there, so the evidence cannot rule out that this block existed as a rare variant before and merely rose in frequency, nor that A22 was already skippable at a low level — sampling differences in variant frequencies between two 200-trace windows can produce such shifts. The internal order of the block also varies, so the evidence pins down only that the four activities run between A21 and A23, not a fixed sequence. Finally, the routing shift at A06 toward A07 is a distinct difference that this hypothesis does not explain, and the evidence provides no link between the two. [REL025, OCC002, DIR001]
